title: Λευτεριά στον Ακίφ Καν!
summary: ANTARSYA calls for mobilization in support of member Akif Khan, a migrant from Kashmir arrested and charged with robbery after a racist incident at a mini-market in Agios Panteleimonas, demanding charges be dropped and his release, with a court gathering scheduled for October 26, 2026.

translation: Comrade Akif Khan, a migrant from Kashmir and member of ANTARSYA, faces a racist conspiracy and is groundlessly accused of a felony.

title: AfD wird Berichterstattung auf Grundlage illegal erlangter Daten nicht unterstützen
summary: The AfD federal party issued a statement on 21 October 2026 declaring it will not cooperate with media reporting based on allegedly stolen party data from a digital attack, calling the data theft a crime and warning that some leaked content appears to be falsified.
speaker: Alternative for Germany
original_quote: Die AfD ist eine Rechtsstaatspartei. Entsprechend eng werden wir mit den staatlichen Stellen auf Bundes- und Landesebene zusammenarbeiten, um jene zur Rechenschaft zu ziehen, die unsere Partei digital angegriffen und Daten gestohlen haben.
translation: The AfD is a rule-of-law party. Accordingly, we will work closely with state authorities at federal and state level to hold accountable those who digitally attacked our party and stole data.

original_quote: Con il nuovo decreto sicurezza illustrato dal presidente Giorgia Meloni, il governo interviene con equilibrio ed efficacia per ristabilire il confine netto tra il legittimo dissenso – come quello espresso civilmente da categorie produttive quali agricoltori, autotrasportatori e lavoratori con cui l'Esecutivo si confronta costantemente – e la pura criminalità.

title: Sicurezza: decreto governo risposta ferma contro violenti

translation: With the new security decree, among other things, we introduce the crime of violent participation in demonstrations with penalties up to 5 years in prison and fines up to 20,000 euros, we affirm the principle that whoever breaks pays – with direct injunctions from the Prefect for public property, immediately executable decrees for private property and parental financial liability for minors –, we intervene on accountability between 14 and 18 years by extending preventive detention to minors and we immediately send 500 more military personnel to Milan until the end of the year.

translation: The climate of witch-hunting during the Covid pandemic was like a totalitarian regime. Journalists, political figures, experts in various fields and even scientific researchers were censored, ridiculed or demonized for having expressed opinions and studies unwelcome to the then-dominant thinking.

title: Covid: censurarono studio su effetti avversi al vaccino
summary: Brothers of Italy parliamentarians Alice Buonguerrieri and Antonella Zedda used testimony in the Covid Commission to criticize alleged censorship of a 2022 study by ISS researcher Loredana Frasca on adverse vaccine effects, particularly myocarditis in young people, and questioned mass vaccination policies during the pandemic.
speaker: Alice Buonguerrieri
original_quote: A chi giovava questa vaccinazione di massa? Ne deve rispondere chi era al governo.
translation: Who benefited from this mass vaccination? Those who were in government must answer for it.

title: Covid: censurarono studio su effetti avversi al vaccino
summary: Brothers of Italy parliamentarians Alice Buonguerrieri and Antonella Zedda used testimony in the Covid Commission to criticize alleged censorship of a 2022 study by ISS researcher Loredana Frasca on adverse vaccine effects, particularly myocarditis in young people, and questioned mass vaccination policies during the pandemic.

original_quote: L'audizione di oggi testimonia che in molti, tra rappresentanti politici e sanitari di allora, hanno minimizzato o persino nascosto l'esito di questo studio per timore che alimentasse sfiducia nei confronti del vaccino anti-Covid. translation: Today's hearing testifies that many, among the political and health representatives of that time, minimized or even hid the outcome of this study for fear that it would fuel distrust towards the anti-Covid vaccine. A disgrace, which debases scientific rigor in favor of political interest.

title: Timo Furuholm: Seisovatko Varsinais-Suomen perussuomalaiset kansanedustajat yli 600 miljoonan euron kuntaleikkausten takana?

Todennäköisesti monessa kunnassa jouduttaisiin tekemään molempia. translation: In such a situation, municipalities are left with only bad options. Either cut services for residents or raise municipal taxes significantly. The Finns Party is used to talking about tax cuts, but with this proposal the debt brake would be transferred directly to be paid by municipal residents

title: Laura Meriluoto: Asuinpaikka ei saa ratkaista oikeutta terveydenhuollon asiakasmaksujen huojennuksiin
summary: Left Alliance vice-chair and MP Laura Meriluoto is collecting signatures in parliament for a legislative initiative to expand wellbeing services areas' obligation to reduce or waive social and healthcare client fees, addressing regional disparities where twelve wellbeing services areas and Helsinki do not allow any reductions for flat-rate healthcare fees.
speaker: Laura Meriluoto
original_quote: Orpo-Purran hallitus on monella tavalla romuttanut suomalaisen yhteiskunnan tasa-arvoa. Yksi räikeimmistä esimerkeistä on sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon asiakasmaksujen enimmäismäärien roimat korotukset.
translation: The Orpo-Purra government has in many ways destroyed the equality of Finnish society. One of the most blatant examples is the massive increases in the maximum amounts of social and healthcare client fees.

title: Laura Meriluoto: Asuinpaikka ei saa ratkaista oikeutta terveydenhuollon asiakasmaksujen huojennuksiin
summary: Left Alliance vice-chair and MP Laura Meriluoto is collecting signatures in parliament for a legislative initiative to expand wellbeing services areas' obligation to reduce or waive social and healthcare client fees, addressing regional disparities where twelve wellbeing services areas and Helsinki do not allow any reductions for flat-rate healthcare fees.
speaker: Laura Meriluoto
original_quote: Kahdellatoista hyvinvointialueella ja Helsingissä terveydenhuollon tasasuuruisiin asiakasmaksuihin ei voi hakea lainkaan alennusta tai perimättä jättämistä. Asiakasmaksun huojentaminen ei saa riippua siitä, minkä hyvinvointialueen järjestämiä palveluja henkilö käyttää.
translation: In twelve wellbeing services areas and Helsinki, one cannot apply for any reduction or waiver of flat-rate healthcare client fees. The reduction of client fees must not depend on which wellbeing services area's services a person uses.

title: Laura Meriluoto: Asuinpaikka ei saa ratkaista oikeutta terveydenhuollon asiakasmaksujen huojennuksiin
summary: Left Alliance vice-chair and MP Laura Meriluoto is collecting signatures in parliament for a legislative initiative to expand wellbeing services areas' obligation to reduce or waive social and healthcare client fees, addressing regional disparities where twelve wellbeing services areas and Helsinki do not allow any reductions for flat-rate healthcare fees.

original_quote: Suomessa julkisten sosiaali- ja terveyspalvelujen maksuja päätyy myös ulosottoon poikkeuksellisen paljon. Vuonna 2025 ulosottoon tuli noin 507 000 sosiaali- ja terveyspalvelujen sekä varhaiskasvatuksen asiakasmaksua.
translation: In Finland, public social and healthcare service fees also end up in debt collection exceptionally often. In 2025, approximately 507,000 client fees for social and healthcare services and early childhood education went to debt collection.

title: Timo Furuholm: Sosiaaliturvan leikkaukset ja terveydenhuollon asiakasmaksujen korotukset vievät suomalaisia todella ahtaalle
summary: Opposition parties including Left Alliance submitted an interpellation to the Orpo-Purra government regarding rising living costs, with MP Timo Furuholm criticizing social security cuts and healthcare fee increases and calling for restoration of basic security protections and affordable housing construction.
speaker: Timo Furuholm
original_quote: Hallitus voisi aloittaa suomalaisten elämän helpottamisen esimerkiksi hautaamalla nyt täällä eduskunnassa käsittelyssä olevat "Rydmanin hinnat" eli terveydenhuollon asiakasmaksujen korotukset ja uudet maksut. Suomessa hyvä terveys ei saa olla kiinni lompakon paksuudesta.
translation: The government could start making life easier for Finns by, for example, burying the so-called 'Rydman prices' currently being processed in parliament, namely the healthcare fee increases and new charges. In Finland, good health must not depend on the thickness of one's wallet.

title: Timo Furuholm: Sosiaaliturvan leikkaukset ja terveydenhuollon asiakasmaksujen korotukset vievät suomalaisia todella ahtaalle
summary: Opposition parties including Left Alliance submitted an interpellation to the Orpo-Purra government regarding rising living costs, with MP Timo Furuholm criticizing social security cuts and healthcare fee increases and calling for restoration of basic security protections and affordable housing construction.

translation: In addition, basic security must now be fixed, protected portions and child supplements restored, and completely stalled social housing construction kicked back into action so that people will have affordable homes in the future as well.

translation: The Finns Party, grinning with scissors in hand at ordinary people, are here again. With this cuts list, social and health services would be destroyed, safety nets would be cut to pieces, and unemployment would be worsened.

title: Aino-Kaisa Pekonen: Perussuomalaisten leikkauslista johtaisi tuhansien hoitajien ja opettajien irtisanomisiin

translation: Finland's unemployment is already the highest in Europe and continues to grow. On top of that, the Finns Party's cuts list would lead to the dismissal of thousands of nurses and teachers. The fate of Finnish workers does not weigh heavily on the Finns Party.

title: Aino-Kaisa Pekonen: Perussuomalaisten leikkauslista johtaisi tuhansien hoitajien ja opettajien irtisanomisiin

title: Pia Lohikoski: Nuorten uskon tulevaisuuteen voi palauttaa vain vastuullinen politiikka
summary: Left Alliance MP Pia Lohikoski delivered a group speech in parliament criticizing the government's report on youth futures for ignoring climate crisis and imposing disproportionate cuts on young people, while proposing to reverse social security cuts, raise student grants, reject tuition fees, and guarantee work or study placements for unemployed youth.

translation: I'm not surprised that young people in Finland are also disappointed in politics. Young people have been only the target of repeated cuts for this government. I hope that we wake up to the distress of young people.

title: Pia Lohikoski: Nuorten uskon tulevaisuuteen voi palauttaa vain vastuullinen politiikka

translation: We in the Left Alliance want to strengthen young people's livelihood by reversing the social security cuts that have been made and raising student grants. We say a firm no to tuition fees and demand a work or study placement for every young person who has been unemployed for three months.

title: Pia Lohikoski: Nuorten uskon tulevaisuuteen voi palauttaa vain vastuullinen politiikka

title: Pia Lohikoski: Nuorten uskon tulevaisuuteen voi palauttaa vain vastuullinen politiikka

title: New Green Party transport policy aims for 75% cut in carbon emissions within ten years
